description: The main window may call only the app's three file commands: show the native open dialog for one SVG drawing or fit profile and read that file once (pick_file, read_picked_file), and show the native save dialog and write one 3MF, STL or JSON file where the user chose (save_file). No dialog, file system, shell, opener or window permission is granted to the webview, and no remote origin is listed.
